caseName: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp. v. Gray
caseNameFull: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation v. R. A. Gray & Co. and Oregon-Washington Carpenters-Employers Pension Trust Fund v. R. A. Gray & Co.

opinions.text: Appeals from C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of G & R Roofing Co. for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 83-245 granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 705 F. 2d 1502.
